// ADR-284 §7a acceptance set — ios-list rebuilt in the builder, generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr284CodeView.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {useState} from 'react';
import {Button, GridList, GridListItem} from 'react-aria-components';
import {useListData} from 'react-aria-components/useListData';
import emailsData from './data/emails';

export default function Home() {
  let [selectionMode, setSelectionMode] = useState('none');
  let emails = useListData({
    initialItems: emailsData,
    getKey: item => item.id
  });
  let {selectedKeys: selectedKeys, setSelectedKeys: setSelectedKeys} = emails;

  return (
    <>
      <Button label="Delete" isDisabled={selectedKeys !== 'all' && selectedKeys.size === 0} onPress={() => {
        emails.removeSelectedItems();
        setSelectionMode('none');
      }} />
      <Button label="Edit" onPress={() => {
        setSelectionMode(v => v === 'multiple' ? 'none' : 'multiple');
        setSelectedKeys(new Set());
      }} />
      <GridList selectionMode={selectionMode} selectedKeys={selectedKeys} onSelectionChange={setSelectedKeys} items={emails.items}>
        {item => <GridListItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.id)}>{item.id}</GridListItem>}
      </GridList>
    </>
  );
}
